messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: You should not use Albuterol if you are allergic to albuterol.
You should not use ProAir RespiClick or ProAir Digihaler if you are allergic to milk proteins.
To make sure albuterol inhalation is safe for you, tell your doctor if you have:
heart disease, high blood pressure, congestive heart failure;
a heart rhythm disorder;
a seizure disorder such as epilepsy;
diabetes;
overactive thyroid; or
low levels of potassium in your blood.
Tell your doctor if you are pregnant or plan to become pregnant.
It is not known whether albuterol will harm an unborn baby.
However, having uncontrolled asthma during pregnancy may increase the risk of premature birth.
It may also increase the risk of low birth weight.
It may also increase the risk of eclampsia.
Eclampsia is dangerously high blood pressure.
Eclampsia can lead to medical problems in both mother and baby.
The benefit of preventing bronchospasm may outweigh any risks to the baby.
If you are pregnant, your name may be listed on a pregnancy registry.
The registry is used to track the effects of albuterol on the baby.
Triplet: ["Albuterol Inhalation", "has pregnancy or breastfeeding instruction", "pregnancy registry may be used to track effects on baby"]

The relation 'has pregnancy or breastfeeding instruction' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug requires the specific instruction or action related to pregnancy or breastfeeding as specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:

B. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'has administration instruction': The subject drug should be taken or used in the manner specified by the object entity (for example with food or at a fixed time).
D. 'manufactured by': The subject drug is manufactured or marketed by the company specified by the object entity.
E. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
